comparisons.reason: Different constructs and scales. Item 0 is a count (non-negative integer) of semantically deduplicated distinct counter-arguments to the OP, and an empty list gives 0. Item 1 is an anchored 0-10 cognitive-complexity score (differentiation plus integration) of the counterarguments taken together, and an empty list gives null. A count of arguments is not a quality or complexity score, and the null rules for empty lists differ.
